terrarium.title: Modular mantis terrarium and untethered instrument rail
terrarium.purpose: Validate a husbandry-safe 250/500 modular enclosure and an untethered, powered-video carriage before fabrication release.

locks.statement: The repositionable carriage is untethered and has no trailing power or video cable.
Protected continuous rail contacts carry power and low-speed control.
Serialized video crosses only an indexed controlled-impedance high-speed pogo dock while stationary.
Raw MIPI CSI remains local to camera/serializer and receiver/compute interfaces and never rides the rail.

Pinching quiesces video and turns the local carriage load branch off before high-speed and continuous contacts lift; while rolling, the carriage branch remains off and all moving contacts are physically clear. Protected VIN lands may remain energized only inside the guarded external channel behind the continuous wet-side barrier.
The removable binder uses a second keyed electrical interface, a normally-open S2 mate interlock, and a mechanical release block unless the carriage is pinch-safe.
Metal, copper, pogos, and electrode strips remain outside animal and wet volumes.
The mantis directory is a biomemetics lab workspace, not a catalog Specimen.
GPS, locality, taxon, biological structure/function, SKUs, pinouts, dimensions, and results require evidence or an explicit unverified status.
Observations remain distinguishable from interpretations, simulations, calculations, and engineering analogs.

sourcesOfTruth.domainAuthority: Each scientific or engineering domain retains its authoritative source; contracts carry identifiers and epistemic status across boundaries.
